notes.title: v1.9.0 Hotfix 3
notes.notes:
v1.9.0 Hotfix 3 

Fixed the last remaining crashes caused by the game engine update (If you do experience a crash, please make a ticket in ⁠help!),

Added a new volume slider for "Crowd" so you can control ambience and crowd noises separately,

Made the default volume for the dash recharge alert 0 while we rethink the sound,

Fixed a bug where the replay would not find the puck correctly after the first replay happened,

Made the camera transitions snappier, reducing the time they take in most scenarios,

Removed the camera transition from replay to your player character after a replay has ended,



This patch resolves the most urgent issues and requests that have made their way to us. If you experience different issues or have requests to drastically improve your experience with Slapshot feel free to let us know in ⁠Discord or through a reply to this post / new post in the Steam forums.



We're very happy with the first 24 hours of the Showdown event, the Yetis are pulling ahead but the Goats and Puffins are not too far behind. Let us know if you're enjoying the event and how we can make them even better the next time around!



You can restart Steam to get the update right away.



GLHF,

Oddshot Games

notes.title: Pond foundations, new settings, cosmetic search bar, backfill changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37173422/70b1dc6323d01e8b950d7539d64e5e7346415116.png

Rebound v0.77.0 is now live ːreboundː

New features and changes
- Implemented the pond as an arena and game mode; this is a barebones foundation that we'll be building on in the coming months
- Added a search bar to your cosmetics
- Added an equip button on the unlock notification when you unlock a new item
- Added controller support for the end game screen
- Disabled controller quick chat for the end game screen (you can still use it after the buzzer, before the end game screen)
- Added a setting for whether you want to use kph or mph for speeds; the setting defaults to mph if you're in the US or UK, kph everywhere else
- Reworked the color picker, you don't need to click save on it anymore and it makes it easier to see transparency in the preview
- Added new settings for premium users: Puck trail color, one for the color on the ice and one for in the air
- Added a new setting that allows you to set the opacity of match info (countdowns, goal scored, etc)
- Increased the offset limit for the resources UI (stamina and dizziness) to allow more freedom in UI customization
- Reworked the props on the outdoor, now featuring Goosan's Hot Grill and Trainer Buddy's Top Cheese!
- Added default placements for the ads, some showcasing the season pass and others being arena specific images
- Reworked the dropdown UI to fit the game's aesthetics better and increased scroll speed for a better user experience

Matchmaking
- Adjusted the backfill criteria, tightening the skill rating it considers to prevent backfill causing an imbalanced match

Cosmetics
- Added galaxy set, lava set, energy set
- Added carbon stick, holo stick
- Added the geese horn from the outdoor as a cosmetic

Fixes
- Reverse cam indicator now shows appropriately even if you have the minimap disabled
- If a spectator is last to leave a custom lobby before the match is finished, it now properly stops the match
- Fixed the tutorial and forfeit UI elements for widescreen players
- Fixed controller button graphics for the bot matches
- Improved outgoing bandwidth usage from input packets
- Renamed the "controller sensitivity" setting to "controller stick speed" and fixed it for online play

GLHF,
Oddshot Games

notes.title: Rebound v0.51.0 - Stability update
notes.notes:
Rebound v0.51.0 - Stability update

For this update, most efforts were focused on stabilising existing infrastructure and Slapshot Services.
Leaderboards are back, lots of database issues have been resolved and other really boring things that'll generally just result in a smoother experience.
We're nowhere near done with all the improvements on that front though, so more of that is coming in later updates.

General
- Reintroducing the leaderboards, real-time this time!
- Added automatic latency / MTR reporting to the game, you can use 'mtr' in the dev console (button under esc) to trigger it manually
- Main menu now has the new Slapshot song (there's another one when you're in a custom lobby)
- Changed a few quickchat options

Arena
- Goal spotlight fades in now instead of being abrupt
- Increased the movements of the arena audience

Cosmetics
- Added variants (in preparation for next patch) for mouthpiece, mouthpuck, devil horns, whistle, star, electric guitar
- Added new cosmetics: Tusks, samurai helmet, cheddar, scratch, lion backpack, skull mask, whiskers, unicorn backpack
- Added item of the month for Patreon supporters: Aviator goggles

Fixes
- Ears no longer show through the futuristic helmet
- Queue notification will no longer make your ears bleed
- Endgame screen text contrast has been improved
- Moved default controller buttons for zoom & spawn puck (replaced by quick chat)

What's next
We're still heavily focusing on stabilising the game, the game may be in Early Access but that doesn't excuse some of the issues that have been occurring. We're working very closely with our host to address some issues there. One idea that'll partially help is to introduce more locations (such as NA Central in Chicago) to bring our servers closer to the people. Other things like the cosmetic variants are still being worked on (but don't take priority over stabilisation). Outdoor arena soon™

notes.title: Balancing changes
notes.notes:
Gameplay changes

- Stopping is now 65% stronger
this will make dekes more viable to create space both on offense and defence

- Sticks no longer lift over other sticks
That will result in less "w key mosh pits" and allow for more skill based battles for the puckLive 

- Fixed issue where the puck would 'wobble' when skating with it on your stick

As always, we will be monitoring games and listening to your feedback. 
These changes were introduced through feedback from several players, both old and new.

Shoutout to the GridIron players that helped reinforce that these changes are a step in the right direction.

- Erveon
